artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation plan for propositional refactoring audit addressing all 7 research issues

memory_candidates.content: When Lean 4 files have duplicate definitions caused by transitive import name collisions, the standard fix pattern is: (1) extract shared definitions into a standalone module importing only the base type definitions, (2) remove the phantom import causing the collision, (3) update all consumers to import the shared module and delete local copies. This extract-remove-update ordering minimizes risk because each step can be independently verified with a scoped lake build.
